title: Tomai Pabo Bole
desc: Two neighbouring families are embroiled in a bitter rivalry. However, in an interesting turn of events, the son of one family falls in love with the daughter of the other.

title: Sati Behula
desc: Savitri is a devoted wife who roams about with her differently abled husband and stands by him despite his difficulties.

title: Manush Keno Beiman
desc: L Chowdhury, a simple villager, who lives with his sister, finds his life turned upside down because of an unexpected accident.

title: Praner Swami
desc: A businessman unsuccessfully looks for a prospective bride for his grandson, Moti. Later, Moti marries a woman, Moyna, of his choice, but she catches his friend's dirty eyes who wants her for himself.

title: Bachchan
desc: Bachchan, a huge fan of Amitabh Bachchan, falls in love with a colonel's daughter and tries to woo her. Later, he finds a mobile which belongs to a ruthless gangster and starts blackmailing him.
